verdict.rationale: A government IP office's digital services could plausibly offer user-configurable background automations, such as automatic renewals or scheduled trade mark watches, so the axis applies. The evidence shows only interactive filing, search and tracking services plus a generic 'Get emails' subscription. That subscription is an adjacent notification feature, not user-defined automations that run autonomously.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
